description: This is a Java test class for the CoreDataTuner component within the org.openmrs.liquibase package. It contains unit tests for methods handling Liquibase changelog files, including reading, updating, detaching/attaching change sets, and extracting database schemas.

classes.name: CoreDataTunerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for verifying the functionality of the CoreDataTuner component's methods related to Liquibase changelog files.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the test environment before each test, setting up CoreDataTuner instance and loading a sample changelog XML document.

methods.name: shouldCreateUpdatedChangeLogFile
methods.description: Tests the creation of an updated changelog file by comparing the generated file with a known expected file.

methods.name: shouldDetachAndCacheChangeSets
methods.description: Tests detaching change sets from the changelog document and caching them within CoreDataTuner.

methods.name: shouldAddChangeSets
methods.description: Verifies that change sets can be added back to a changelog document after detachment.

methods.name: shouldGetDatabaseChangeLogElement
methods.description: Checks retrieval of the core databaseChangeLog XML element.

methods.name: shouldMergeTableNamesInTargetOrder
methods.description: Tests merging two lists of table names in a specific target order.

methods.name: shouldDetectThatSecondListDoesNotContainFirstList
methods.description: Ensures that an assertion error is thrown if the second list does not contain all elements of the first.

methods.name: shouldUpdateAdminUser
methods.description: Tests updating an admin user within the changelog document.

methods.name: shouldGetTableNames
methods.description: Verifies extraction of table names from the changelog document.

methods.name: assertAttributeValue
methods.description: Helper method to verify the value of an attribute in an XML element selected via XPath.

methods.name: mergeLists
methods.description: Utility to merge two lists preserving order and ensuring all elements of the first are contained in the second.

methods.name: getTableNames
methods.description: Extracts distinct table names from the changelog XML document.
